name_zh: 穆罕默德五世/摩洛哥/殖民独立协商
core_mode: M245 殖民独立协商/苏丹权威/民族统一战线
intellectual_tradition: 伊斯兰苏丹制/殖民抵抗/民族协商独立
description_zh: 穆罕默德五世（1909-1961），摩洛哥阿拉维王朝苏丹，1927年至1961年在位。在法国和西班牙殖民统治时期，他通过巧妙运用伊斯兰苏丹的宗教权威和政治智慧，与民族独立运动协商合作，最终实现了摩洛哥的和平独立。
description_en: Mohammed V (1909-1961), Sultan of the Alaouite dynasty of Morocco, reigned from 1927 to 1961. During the French and Spanish colonial period, he skillfully used his religious authority as an Islamic sultan to negotiate with the nationalist independence movement and ultimately achieved Morocco's peaceful independence.
reason_zh: 穆罕默德五世是殖民独立协商的典范。他巧妙平衡了传统苏丹权威与近代民族主义，通过伊斯兰合法性与政治协商相结合的方式，成功引导摩洛哥走向独立。他的模式体现了传统权威在殖民转型中的核心价值。
reason_en: Mohammed V is the exemplar of colonial independence negotiation. He skillfully balanced traditional sultan authority with modern nationalism, using Islamic legitimacy combined with political consultation to guide Morocco toward independence. His model demonstrates the core value of traditional authority in colonial transitions.
steps_zh: 苏丹继位：1927年继承王位/法国保护国框架内的有限权力
殖民抵抗时期：1930-1944 反对卡萨布兰卡章程/保护犹太裔臣民/与民族独立运动接触
流亡协商：1953-1955 被法国流放科西嘉/国际施压后回归
独立建国：1956-1961 摩洛哥正式独立/建立现代国家体制
steps_en: Sultan succession: 1927 ascending the throne/limited power under French protectorate framework
Colonial resistance period: 1930-1944 opposed Casablanca charter/protected Jewish subjects/contacted nationalist independence movement
Exile negotiation: 1953-1955 exiled to Corsica by France/returned after international pressure
Independence and statebuilding: 1956-1961 Morocco formal independence/modern state system established
expected_zh: 成功实现摩洛哥和平独立，建立现代国家体制。穆罕默德五世成为北非殖民转型的典范。
expected_en: Successfully achieved Morocco's peaceful independence and established a modern state system. Mohammed V became the exemplar of North African colonial transition.
case_zh: 1909出生/1927继位/1930反对章程/1944卡萨布兰卡大会/1953流放科西嘉/1955回归/1956独立/1961逝世/摩洛哥独立之父。
case_en: 1909 birth/1927 succession/1930 opposed charter/1944 Casablanca congress/1953 exiled to Corsica/1955 returned/1956 independence/1961 death/father of Moroccan independence.
